status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
shortlistPerRace: union of the top 15 distinct official tickets from each of six pre-race source scores; no outcome-based filtering
sourceScores: top2/top3 marginal-corrected probability(alpha=1.0) x official odds
strict-OOS marginal-pair-v2 probability x official odds
prior-OOS calibrated marginal-pair-v2 probability x official odds
candidateFeatures: locked 65 marginal-pair-v2 features plus the ticket's rank under each of the six shortlist source scores (16 if outside that source's top15), minimum source rank, mean source rank and number of sources selecting the ticket
ticketRanking: predicted strict-OOS hit probability multiplied by corresponding JRA official odds; wide uses official lower bound
evaluation: actual JRA top1/top3/top5/top9 return rates among the shortlist, plus winning-ticket shortlist coverage
